assumptions: Principal business (CG-02): taken as the code with the most payroll outside C-110, measured from the records.
Office staff who sign in at job sites are not confined to an office (CG-04); without time records (CG-07) their whole payroll goes to the principal business code (CG-02), however few the visits.
Subcontractor names (CG-06): a payment name that is a shortened form of a certificate holder's name (for example without 'LLC' or a trade) is taken as the same company.

Uninsured subcontractors (CG-06): the full amount paid is treated as payroll under the code for the work, and the payment date is taken as the date of the work, because the file has no labor and material split and no work dates.
